payload.title: Tomato leaves turning brown - any ideas?
payload.body_html:
Tomato leaves turning brown - any ideas?

gardener_ann: The lower leaves on my tomatoes are turning brown at the edges. I water in the morning and the plants get full sun. Has anyone seen this before?

plotholder_raj: Sounds like early blight to me. Remove the affected leaves and mulch the soil so rain does not splash spores upward.

payload.title: Best way to store winter tyres?
payload.body_html:
Best way to store winter tyres?

I have a set of winter tyres and limited garage space. Is it fine to stack them flat, or should they hang on a wall rack?

Reply: Stack them flat if they are off the rims, and rotate the stack every couple of months.

payload.content:
My starter has started to smell sharp and fruity after a week. Is it ruined?

Reply: It is just hungry. Feed it twice a day for a few days and the smell will settle.

payload.title: Tomato leaves curling upward
payload.body_html:
Tomato leaves curling upward

The upper leaves on my tomato plants are curling. The fruit looks fine. Should I worry?

Reply: Leaf roll is usually caused by heat or heavy pruning. It rarely affects the harvest.
